protocol.name: worktree5-same-harness-native-engine-1
protocol.worker: byte-identical reference/agent_worker.py; inject only CodeService.adapter for native
protocol.execution: serial, original task/repeat Latin rotation; identical task root per triple
protocol.engine_readiness: outside formal runs; never expose probes to model
protocol.quality: original fixed tests and source/test integrity; exact target/caller set and locations
protocol.cost: same reference timing and observed usage; index separate; no currency claims
protocol.retry_policy: retain all formal failures; no success-based retries; infrastructure failures explicitly reported
protocol.analysis: paired per-task per-repeat ratios and raw score counts; six independent tasks, no superiority/noninferiority claim
protocol.native_boundary: native extraction, resolution, immutable SQLite and search ranking; shared engine.cjs selection/traversal policy including ambiguity guard
protocol.reference_comparison: previous 36 runs historical only; fresh controls used for engine comparison
protocol.repair_supplement: repeat unreadable-file behavioral check for all six symlink patches; never rewrite original pass scores
protocol.no_retuning: freeze scripts before first model call; no engine/prompt/schema/budget/scoring changes during cohort

publication_delivery.scope: Typed cross-snapshot imports, direct/package import support, module-loader guards, JSON formatting and complete license headers; no model reruns or executable native engine changes.
